Remark
[distance functions persist under a compatible metric change]

Source: petersen:page-0239 ↗ rem:pet-ch5-distance-function-geodesics 1. ch5:5.9.16Let $r:U o \mathbb R$ be a distance function w.r.t. $g$. If $ ar g$ satisfies $ ar g( abla r,v)=g( abla r,v)$ for all $v$ (gradient taken w.r.t. $g$), show $r$ is also a distance function w.r.t. $ ar g$.
